description: This file defines the OA_Dll_Agency class, which manages agency data and statistics within the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for CRUD operations, data validation, and retrieving various statistics related to agencies.

classes.name: OA_Dll_Agency
classes.description: Class for managing agency data, validation, and statistics in the Revive Adserver.

methods.name: _setAgencyDataFromArray
methods.description: Populates an OA_Dll_AgencyInfo object with data from an array.

methods.name: _validate
methods.description: Validates agency data, including email, language, and status.

methods.name: _validateLanguage
methods.description: Checks if a language is available.

methods.name: _validateStatus
methods.description: Checks if a status is allowed.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Creates or updates an agency record, including user account linking.

methods.name: getAgencyList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all agencies.

methods.name: getAgencyDailyStatistics
methods.description: Fetches daily statistics for an agency.

methods.name: getAgencyHourlyStatistics
methods.description: Fetches hourly statistics for an agency.

methods.name: getAgencyAdvertiserStatistics
methods.description: Fetches advertiser statistics for an agency.

methods.name: getAgencyCampaignStatistics
methods.description: Fetches campaign statistics for an agency.

methods.name: getAgencyBannerStatistics
methods.description: Fetches banner statistics for an agency.

methods.name: getAgencyPublisherStatistics
methods.description: Fetches publisher statistics for an agency.

methods.name: getAgencyZoneStatistics
methods.description: Fetches zone statistics for an agency.
